integrity: The lower bound and equality case are proved by exact abundancy inequalities and an exhaustive case split on the exponent of 2. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the minimum total-prime-factor layer. It does not classify triperfect numbers with Omega at least six or settle whether the six known triperfect numbers are complete.
title: The first multiplicity layer of triperfect numbers
